units: <cite ref="Yoma 54b">Yoma 54ᵇ</cite> top (ref. to <he>וליות</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 7:36">I Kings VII, 36</cite>), v. <cite ref="P01342"><he>עָרָה</he> II</cite>.

Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵈ top, [read:] לא תעורר אשה לְוִיָּיתָהּ … רבי נחמן … אמר לִיוְיָתָהּ a woman must not stir up her company for wailing during the festive week; R. N. read livyatha (with ref. to עורר לויתן Job III, 8; cmp. אִילַּוָּיוּתָא).
